boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 136 splits the board into an upper grid with border numbers gating each slide direction and a lower panel centered on a `13` circle with four colored arrows forming a second scoring zone. The red L-tetromino and yellow 2×2 square compete for center space — clear the cyan up-arrow feeds through the `2` border first, or the lower panel runs out of incoming pieces.
landmarks: Block Out Level 136 splits the board into an upper grid with border numbers gating each slide direction and a lower panel centered on a `13` circle with four colored arrows forming a second scoring zone.
The red L-tetromino and yellow 2×2 square compete for center space — clear the cyan up-arrow feeds through the `2` border first, or the lower panel runs out of incoming pieces.
The board mixes Purple, Green, Blue and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Break the yellow 2×2 before sliding the cyan right bar — reversing that order locks the lower 13 above 4.
Feed the red L-tetromino through the purple left-arrow only after both side 9 counters clear.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the top purple/green/blue cluster rightward to spend the 2 and 4 top counters without splitting the cyan/yellow right pair.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Feed the red left column down the green down-arrow lane to start spending the left 9 border counter.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Break the yellow 2×2 square in the upper-center once the right 9 counter drops to 6.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Push the red L-tetromino leftward through the purple left-arrow lane after both side 9 counters clear.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Slide the cyan vertical bar on the right edge down the red right-arrow lane to unlock the lower panel.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Spend the lower 9 tile in the orange circle and feed the last scraps down the yellow up-arrow for the board clear.

failurePoints: Sliding the cyan right bar before the yellow 2×2 breaks, locking the lower 13 circle above 4.
Pushing the red L-tetromino left before both side 9 counters clear, stranding the lower panel.
